name: stunning-sunset-yacht-bikini-beauties
image_purpose: swimwear lookbook and yacht lifestyle campaign

prompt.project_info: Create a vertical 3:4 photorealistic sunset yacht editorial with two original approved adult women, preserving the colorful swimwear, boat wake, and tropical mountain backdrop.
prompt.main_subject: Two original approved adult women with natural fit curvy figures and feminine silhouettes. The blonde woman on the left wears a purple-and-yellow bikini and turns toward camera with a poised smile. The dark-haired woman on the right wears a green-and-white bikini with a supplied sports-style graphic and raises a glass of white wine with a relaxed expression. Keep both subjects adult, natural, and non-sexualized.
composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 framing, mid-thigh-up view of two women seated on the stern of a moving modern motorboat.
Blonde subject turned toward camera; dark-haired subject reclines slightly and raises the wine glass.
Wide frothy wake trails behind the boat.
Tropical mountains silhouette against fiery orange, pink, and purple sunset clouds.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour light from the setting sun, soft long shadows, natural skin highlights, tropical sunset color, and celebratory luxury mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Sharp high-resolution candid photorealistic photography, vibrant warm colors, 3:4 aspect ratio, realistic water wake, glass, skin, and fabric texture, no extra typography or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Vertical 3:4 photorealistic photograph of two original approved adult women with natural fit curvy figures and feminine silhouettes seated on the stern of a modern motorboat during a scenic sunset cruise. The blonde woman on the left wears a purple-and-yellow bikini, turns toward the camera with a poised smile, and keeps a relaxed natural posture. The dark-haired woman on the right wears a green-and-white bikini with a supplied sports-style graphic, reclines slightly, and raises a glass of white wine with a relaxed expression. The boat moves through tropical waters with a wide frothy white wake. Lush tropical mountains silhouette against a dramatic sky of fiery orange, pink and purple clouds. Warm golden-hour light, sharp high-resolution candid photorealistic quality, realistic natural skin and fabric, no celebrity likeness, no extra text, no watermark.
